evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If a required-edge description is not fully derivable from committed artifacts and the bridge's own abstention record, emit source_gap with the precise missing evidence. Never invent an edge, a root, a lexeme or a sense, and never upgrade a description into an accepted edge. Prefer pending over wrong.
evidence_policy.statement: Every inventory row cites the bridge record's contract_id, its canonical quran loc, its exact written surface, and the authority digests it was computed against. A carried-table lookup is source-addressed candidate evidence about a written surface; it is never, by itself, evidence of lexeme identity, sense or function. Describing the typed edge an occurrence would require is a statement of what is MISSING, never an assertion that the edge exists or is accepted.

expected_outputs.description: the frozen inventory: one row per missing_typed_graph_evidence occurrence carrying canonical loc, exact written surface, required-edge description, bridge contract id, and the authority digests it was computed against. A description of a required edge is NOT an edge.

scope.summary: REPORT-ONLY. The A3 bridge is executable and abstention-first: lexical identity requires an accepted canonical typed lexeme/form edge agreeing on occurrence loc, exact written surface and entry, and the committed typed-graph bundles supply 0 eligible edges at 0 occurrence locs under the round-6 content contract. The real-data scan therefore records 0 candidate records among 2,000 carried crosswalk rows, of which 95 reached the typed-graph gate and abstained as missing_typed_graph_evidence. The only product here is a frozen inventory of those exact 95 rows - canonical loc, exact written surface, required-edge description, bridge contract id, and the authority digests each row was computed against - written to a single reports directory. No typed edge is written, nothing is certified, no bridge guard changes, and no public or live output is produced. On success the terminal state is the bounded evidence-inventory state EVIDENCE_READY_FOR_OWNER_CERTIFICATION; GAP-L3 remains open and the bridge candidate count remains zero. A separate owner-authorized evidence packet, exact evidence review, and owner-gated application of accepted typed edges are all required before any later bridge rerun could emit a real candidate.
